# Custom Upper Mount Plate Fabrication

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Fabricate a custom upper mount plate from aluminum to fit an R32/R34 radiator. [t1492]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Measure the bottom pins of the new radiator against the OEM bushings.
2. Thread the upper mounting pins to a size of 3/8" NF as far down as possible.
3. Cut an aluminum sheet measuring 26 inches on the rear and 28 inches at the front into a trapezoid shape.
4. Drill holes in the plate for the upper mounting pins.
5. Notch out the center of the plate to fit around the filler neck.
6. Create rubber washers that measure 1.25" with a 3/8" center hole.
7. Install the new radiator by dropping it into place so the lower pins sit in the bushings.
8. [Partial] Connect all hoses, ensuring they line up correctly.
9. Clean and round off the edges of the custom upper mounting plate.
10. Drill a hole for the hood holder rod clip on the plate.
11. Smooth out any burrs left from drilling.

_Procedure reported by [t1492]._

## Parts

- [Partial] Aluminum Diamond Plate: 28x6 inch sheet, cut to 26 inches rear [t1492]
- Custom Upper Mount Plate: Aluminum diamond plate or similar material [t1492]
- [Partial] R32/R34 Radiator: Passenger side inlet/outlet, 34mm ports [t1492]
- Rubber Washers: 1.25 inch diameter with 3/8 inch center hole [t1492]

## Specifications

- **Plate Rear Width**: 26" [t1492] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Plate Sheet Size (Start)**: 28" x 6" [t1492] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Radiator Port Size**: 34mm [t1492] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Rubber Washer Diameter**: 1.25" [t1492] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Upper Pin Thread Size**: 3/8" NF [t1492] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Round the cut edges of the plate for a clean finish. [t1492]
- Drill a hole in the plate to accommodate the hood holder rod clip. [t1492]
- [Partial] Measure radiator bottom pins before installation; they should match OEM. [t1492]
- Note that R34 upper mounting pins are narrower than standard OEM. [t1492]
